description: This Dart source file defines the CategoryRepository class, which provides domain-specific operations for managing categories in the wallet application. It includes methods for seeding default categories, listing all categories, adding, updating, removing, and retrieving categories by ID. The class interacts with a data access object (CategoryDao) and manages some state persistence via SharedPreferences.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository providing domain-friendly operations for categories, including seeding defaults, CRUD operations, and retrieval.

methods.name: ensureSeeded
methods.description: Seeds default categories on first run if not already seeded, by inserting predefined categories.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all categories via DAO.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new category to the data store, validating required fields and enforcing uniqueness.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing category identified by its ID, validating inputs.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.
